caption:
Koko booked a massage for the first time in ages, then got stuck on the health form. Is all of that really needed? Yes, and here's why.

Heart conditions, blood pressure changes, a history of blood clots or medications that affect clotting all change how firm the pressure should be and which areas are worked. Recent injuries or surgery, pregnancy, diabetes, osteoporosis and cancer treatment are worth mentioning too.

Feeling unwell with a fever, or a rash or skin infection, is a reason to reschedule. It looks after you and the next client.

Everything you share stays confidential and simply helps plan a safe, comfortable session. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio read your form and tailor the session. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
